title: Lexicon-driven controlled-language composition into typed first-order formulas
independentExamples: A nested conditional whose consequent contains an only-if implication
A quantified relational clause with an existential or universal object
English and nonce-language clauses with completely renamed constants, predicates, classes, and relation frames
inputTypes: declarative unary or binary predicate frames with typed placeholder arity
preconditions: every semantic content word used by an accepted atomic predication resolves through exactly one supplied frame
predicate frames contain one subject placeholder and at most one object placeholder
the complete sentence belongs to the declared quantifier and connective fragment
lexicon, input length, composition depth, and variable supply remain within explicit bounds
invariants: the compiler never sees a benchmark identity, row identity, expected formula, or answer position
an unresolved atomic clause or ambiguous frame causes whole-sentence abstention rather than partial formula emission
only-if preserves antecedent-to-necessary-condition direction and unless is represented as negated-condition implication
quantifier scope and relation argument order derive from syntax and frame placeholders
the conservative equivalence checker accepts only declared sound rewrites and may reject equivalent formulas it cannot prove
uncertaintySemantics: UNPARSED means no safe formula was constructed for the complete sentence. RESOURCE_LIMIT means an explicit character, lexicon, depth, or variable bound was exceeded. Neither status supplies a formula.
proofBehavior: The result hashes the normalized sentence and declarative lexicon and records a canonical formula. Verification recompiles the unchanged input and compares the typed formula. Host scoring parses the isolated reference only after prediction and uses alpha normalization, double-negation elimination, associative and commutative Boolean normalization, and explicitly guarded quantifier-lifting equivalences.
kbMigration: No KB schema, package, registry, planner, engine, or existing language representation changes. The candidate is invoked only by the LogicSkills development adapter pending broader language evidence and specification synchronization.
freshPolicy: No fresh member is opened for this candidate. Runtime registration remains deferred.
